# Index of the shipped examples

One working example of every native object kind, on made-up data (a small shop). When this project has no object of the kind you need, copy the example from here, change its names and fields, and run `python scripts/check_project.py .`. Ask the developer only when no example exists.

- All file paths below start at `tests/fixtures/examples/`.
- The examples carry no styling: no colour, font, size, border or shadow. The theme does that work. Every visual has header icons off and tooltips off; the one tooltip example carries its exception.
- **Verified** means three things, for every row: the file parses (model files load in Microsoft's Tabular Object Model library, version 19.118.3, and pass its validation); report files pass Microsoft's schema (`python scripts/json_schema.py`); and the whole folder passes the project check with no error and no warning (`python scripts/check_project.py tests/fixtures/examples`). The tests run the last two on every run.
- **Not yet opened in Desktop**: every row. Nothing here has been opened in Power BI Desktop by the template's builder. Microsoft's own skill warns that a wrong field or role can pass validation and still show an error icon, and Microsoft's library does not parse DAX or Power Query. Look at the result in Desktop the first time you use an example of a kind.
- Status is the release status Microsoft states: GA, preview, or retiring. A preview example is used only after the developer's yes (section 11 of the brief).
- The project check skips this folder when it checks a project; it is checked only when named.

## Starter project and measures table

| Kind | File | Used by | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| A whole new project: `.pbip`, report (one empty page), model (the `_Measures` table) | `starter/` | `python scripts/scaffold.py project <Name>` | GA |
| The `_Measures` table of an import model (one hidden column, no data) | `measures-table/import.tmdl` | `python scripts/scaffold.py measures-table` | GA |
| The `_Measures` table as a calculated table, for a Direct Lake or DirectQuery model | `measures-table/calculated.tmdl` | `python scripts/scaffold.py measures-table` | GA |

The starter registers a placeholder theme so that it passes the check here. `scaffold.py` leaves the theme out (the developer imports it in Power BI Desktop) unless it is run with `--register-theme`.

Notes on the model examples:

- Every model file was written by Microsoft's TMDL serializer from a model built with Microsoft's library, then given its description lines; none was typed from memory.
- The field parameters carry the extended property `ParameterMetadata = {"version":3,"kind":2}`. Microsoft's own skill gives this value; no Microsoft Learn page states it.
- The numeric range parameter carries no such property: Microsoft Learn does not show what Power BI Desktop writes there.
- Not built, and why: legacy data sources and `query` partitions (a Power BI project uses Power Query partitions); `policyRange` partitions (the service makes them when it applies a refresh policy); `variation` (it belongs to Auto date/time, which the standard turns off); connection binding hints; role members (they are assigned in the Power BI service).
- `preview/DirectLakeComposite.SemanticModel` is at compatibility level 1705, the level Microsoft's library requires for `expressionContext`. That Power BI Desktop accepts 1705 is not confirmed.
- Microsoft Learn writes `selectionExpressionBehavior: automatic | nonvisual | visual`; the serializer writes `nonVisual`. The example keeps the serializer's spelling.
- `storage/DynamicParameter.SemanticModel` causes M411 on purpose (the table RegionChoice only feeds the parameter), and M118 because Microsoft allows no spaces in a table name here; both rows are in section 9 of the examples' brief.
- Also not built in the model, and why:
  - Composite model on a published semantic model (DirectQuery to a Power BI semantic model or Analysis Services), and EXTERNALMEASURE: Microsoft Learn gives no file form for the remote-model expression or its partitions; EXTERNALMEASURE needs that connection.
  - Grouping and binning (group and bin columns): Learn describes only the Desktop dialogs, not how a group is stored.
  - Direct Lake on SQL with `OneLake.SqlAnalytics()`: Learn names the connector but shows no expression.
  - Automatic aggregations options: Microsoft keeps the setting outside the model (set in the service); the library property `automaticAggregationOptions` has no documented use in a project.
  - Python and R script sources: they run code on the developer's machine; guidance only.
  - Copilot folder (`Copilot/schema.json`, `Instructions/`, `VerifiedAnswers/`, `examplePrompts.json`, `settings.json`): Learn shows the folder in the definition layout but never says the files are edited by hand; the template's rule 17 keeps linguistic setup in Power BI. Verified answers do not support Git integration at all.
  - `changedProperty`: Power BI writes it; Learn gives only the TOM class.
  - Direct Lake from Fabric SQL databases, mirrored databases and mirrored catalogs: the same two expression forms; no separate example (Learn gives no other form).
  - Multi-select and Select-all binding of a dynamic M query parameter: Learn shows only the Desktop switches, not the stored form.

## Report features

Features of visuals and pages beyond the visual type. Each example sits on a page of its own kind: Filters_Kinds, Charts_Features, Tables_Features, Slicers_More, Data_Function and Drillthrough_CrossReport. How each is stored, and when to use it, is in `.github/skills/pbi-report/references/visual-features.md`.

## Not built

| Kind | Why |
|---|---|
| Q&A visual | `qnaVisual` Microsoft's CLI 0.5.0 `catalog list` marks it deprecated: "Q&A visual is not supported in PBIR authoring workflows"; the visual itself is being retired (Dec 2026 / Feb 2027). |
| Map (Bing) and filled map | `map`, `filledMap` Deprecated. Microsoft's skill (authoring/map.md) says they "must never be created" and the CLI flags them PBIR_VISUAL_TYPE_DEPRECATED; Azure Maps is the shipped map example. |
| Metrics (scorecard) visual | `scorecard` No data roles; it binds to a scorecard item in the service, whose reference form no source gives. |
| Power Apps and Power Automate visuals | not in the catalogue Identifiers not confirmed by any of the four sources. |
| Other catalogue entries | `animatedNumber`, `heatMap`, `realTimeLineChart`, `accessibleTable`, `dataQueryVisual`, `filterSlicer`, `table`, `matrix` Not documented as visuals in the Visualizations pane (internal, streaming-dashboard or legacy aliases); `tableEx` and `pivotTable` are the table and matrix. |
| Bookmark navigator bound to a bookmark group | - A bookmark group now ships (`bookmarks.json`), but the navigator's `bookmarks.bookmarkGroup` property has no stated type in Microsoft's catalogue, and Microsoft's skill (authoring/bookmark.md) says "Do not guess the bookmarks.bookmarkGroup expression shape". The navigator ships unbound (shows all bookmarks). |
| Average, minimum, maximum, median, percentile and trend lines | - The catalogue lists the objects (`referenceLine`, `trend`), but no source shows how a line's kind and measure are stored. The constant line ships. |
| Error bars | - The `error` object's `errorRange` has no stated type in the catalogue, and no source shows it. |
| Forecast and anomaly detection | - The `forecast` and `anomalyDetection` objects keep their settings (length, confidence, sensitivity) in a `transform` property that has no stated type, and no source shows it. |
| Colour scale (gradient) in theme colours | - Microsoft's skill (design/color.md) says `ThemeDataColor` does not work inside a `FillRule`, and the owner's rule forbids colour codes on a visual. The theme sets the colour-scale colours. |
| Conditional formatting of chart lines and legends | - It needs a `FillRule` (see the row above) or a measure that returns a colour; the shipped model has no colour measure. |
| Show value as (percent of a total) | - No source shows how the choice is stored in the files. |
| Inline hierarchy labels (an Expand all state) | - No source shows how an expanded axis is stored. The hierarchy itself ships on a chart. |
| Automatic page refresh | - The page schema lists `objects.pageRefresh` with untyped properties (`show`, `refreshType`, `duration`, `checkEvery`, `measure`), no source gives their values, and Microsoft Learn says import models do not support it. |
| Card images and card layout (hero image, callout layout, fixed size) | - No source shows the card's image value; the layout settings are styling, which the theme does. |
| Custom totals | - The schema defines `QueryCustomTotalMetadata`, but no source shows a visual that uses it. |
| Report settings in a second report | - A report has one `report.json`. The shipped one sets only `settings.useCrossReportDrillthrough`; the other settings are described in `.github/skills/pbi-report/references/visual-features.md`. |
| .platform file | - Rule 9 of pbir.instructions.md: not written by hand; Desktop writes it on save. |

Custom visuals are outside this template.

## Not confirmed in the report examples

- The visual that uses the report-level measure names it with a schema of `extension`; that form is read from Microsoft's schema descriptions. Microsoft Learn describes report-level measures for reports on a published model.
- The R and Python visuals have fields and no script; the paginated report visual is not connected to a paginated report; the smart narrative has no saved text.
- A hierarchy level's `queryRef` is written `Table.Hierarchy.Level` (for example `Date.Calendar.Year`). The schema asks only for a name unique in the visual; Microsoft's skill shows the form only for auto date levels.
- The relative time filter follows the one template Microsoft's skill gives for both relative types, with hour units throughout; the skill shows no relative time filter saved by Desktop.
- The sparkline column's `queryRef` and `nativeQueryRef` are names of this template's own; the schema gives the `SparklineData` form only.
- The data bars use `ThemeDataColor` for their colours; Microsoft's skill shows them with colour codes only.
- `requireSingleSelect` and `isInvertedSelectionMode` on a filter card are untyped in the schema; they are written as literals, like other formatting properties.
- The constant line and the series labels are written without a selector; the catalogue gives their properties, not their selectors. The value axis `start` is written as a number literal; the catalogue leaves its type open.
- The data function button carries made-up ids (all zeros) and a made-up function name; it stays disabled until the developer picks a real function in Desktop.
- The cross-report drillthrough page works only in the Power BI service, with a source report in the same workspace.
- Microsoft's command-line validator (`powerbi-report-author validate`, version 0.5.0, run offline on a copy) found no problem with roles, types, filters, bookmarks or layout. The run was repeated after the report features were added, with the same result. It reported two things that come from the form of these test folders: no `.platform` file, and the placeholder theme's inner name differing from its file name.

Checklist items: none
